parking.name: Torry Battery Parking Areas
parking.detail: Three parking areas beside Torry Battery plus an overflow farther along Greyhope Road. Disabled bays are in the upper area; the operator does not publish total spaces, tariffs, payment methods, maximum stay or overnight rules, so check signs.

toilets.name: Greyhope Bay Accessible Toilets
toilets.detail: Two accessible off-grid dry composting toilets maintained by Greyhope Bay and open during centre hours.

picnic.name: Torry Battery Picnic Viewpoint
picnic.detail: Outdoor benches and grass around the Battery provide an informal picnic stop with harbour and coastal views; no table count or reservable provision is published.
